ns2:section.sectionText: MUSIC PLAY - 1 CREDIT HOUR Students enrolled in this class will study classical music in an experiential setting. Each class will focus on physical movement, creative writing, class discussions, critical listening, and group activities. Students will collaborate to create a performance that showcases their comprehension of the music selected by the instructor. Throughout these learning experiences students will learn general history of each piece in a social context and develop creative skills in an educational setting.
